description: This file implements a Krisp VIVA SDK-based audio filter for noise reduction in the Pipecat project. It defines the KrispVivaFilter class, which manages SDK initialization, configuration, and real-time audio processing, including starting, stopping, and filtering audio frames.

classes.name: KrispVivaFilter
classes.description: A Python class implementing a real-time noise reduction filter using the Krisp VIVA SDK, supporting multiple sample rates and managing SDK sessions.

methods.name: _log_callback
methods.description: A callback function for logging messages from the Krisp SDK.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KrispVivaFilter with optional model path and noise suppression level, validating the model file.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Configures and starts the Krisp SDK session with the specified sample rate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the Krisp SDK session.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Handles control frames to enable or disable filtering.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Processes input audio bytes to apply noise reduction, returning processed audio.

methods.name: _int_to_sample_rate
methods.description: Converts an integer sample rate to the corresponding Krisp SDK SamplingRate enum.
